scraped.scraped_description: Your Priorities is an idea generation, deliberation   decision-making platform helping governments making better decisions since 2008 in thousands of projects. Explore Your Priorities: https://citizens.is/getting-started/

name: Your Priorities
tagline: Idea generation, deliberation & decision-making platform for governments since 2008
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Moderate - relies on Node.js/JavaScript ecosystem and PostgreSQL database; community maintenance of open-source components
news_articles: Your Priorities platform used in Icelandic citizen consultation processes
Participatory budgeting initiatives across European municipalities
academic_citations: Citations in participatory democracy and e-governance literature
awards: Recognition as leading participatory democracy platform in Europe
policy_outcomes: Participatory budgeting decisions implemented in multiple municipalities
Citizen consultation processes integrated into government decision-making
outcome_methodology: Case studies and government partnership reports
published_performance_metrics: User engagement statistics and participation rates reported by deploying governments
failure_modes: Low participation rates in some deployments
governance_model: Social enterprise governance with stakeholder input from government partners and civil society
curation_criteria: Community-driven idea prioritization with moderation for relevance and feasibility
contributor_governance: Open-source contribution guidelines on GitHub; core team maintains platform direction
disparity_tracking: Monitoring of participation demographics across different user groups and geographies
community_ownership: Partial - platform operated by social enterprise with government and community stakeholder engagement

government_partnerships.nature: Platform deployment for participatory budgeting and citizen consultation

ai_involvement: Minimal - primarily uses algorithmic ranking and filtering for idea prioritization
